login.title: Sign in to Password Depot Server
login.connectionFailedDetail: Could not connect to the server. Please verify the address is correct and the server is running. If using HTTPS with a private certificate, make sure the CA certificate is trusted on this device.
login.azureHint: Click Sign In to authenticate with your Microsoft account.
login.negotiateHint: Click Sign In to authenticate with your Windows credentials.
login.webauthnHint: Enter your username, then click Sign In to use your passkey.
login.oidcNoProviders: No identity providers configured on this server.
login.negotiateFailed: Windows single sign-on failed. Verify that your browser is configured to allow integrated authentication for this server (Chrome/Edge: AuthServerAllowlist policy; Firefox: network.negotiate-auth.trusted-uris) and that your account is domain-joined.
login.sspiFailed: Windows authentication failed. Check that the username is in DOMAIN\user or user@domain form and that the password is correct.
login.oidcFailed: Sign-in via the identity provider failed. Verify the provider's redirect URI, client ID, and that this device can reach the discovery URL.
login.oidcValidationFailed: Sign-in could not be completed. Please try again.
login.tfaEmailSendFailed: The server cannot send the verification email right now. Please contact your administrator.
login.tfaEmailMissing: Your account has no email address for two-factor authentication. Please contact your administrator.

tfa.title: Two-Factor Authentication
tfa.description: Enter the 6-digit verification code to complete sign in.
tfa.scanQrCode: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the code below.

vault.truncatedNotice: Showing the first {{count}} items. Use search to find items beyond this limit.

oneTimeCode.loadFailed: The one-time code could not be loaded.

document.downloadWarningDesc: This document will be saved to your device in unencrypted form. Make sure to delete the file from your device when you no longer need it. Do not store it in unsecured locations.

session.expiringDescription: Your session will expire due to inactivity. Any unsaved changes may be lost.

profile.title: User Profile
profile.adSyncNote: Changes may be overwritten on the next Active Directory sync.

passkey.description: Sign in without a password using biometrics or a security key
passkey.empty: No passkeys registered yet. Add one to enable passwordless sign-in.
passkey.deleteDesc: Are you sure you want to remove the passkey "{{name}}"? You will no longer be able to sign in with this device.
passkey.registerAlreadyExists: This authenticator is already registered for your account

options.title: Options
options.defaultServerDesc: Pre-filled on the login page when no recent server is available

entryForm.name: Name
entryForm.invalidValidThru: Valid Thru must be in MM/YYYY format (e.g. 08/2028).
entryForm.expiresFromValidThru: Set automatically from Valid Thru for Credit Card entries.
entryForm.linkedNotice: This entry's login and password are linked from another entry and cannot be edited here.

oneTimeCode.title: One-Time Code
oneTimeCode.removeDesc: The secret is deleted from the server when you save. To set up the code again, a new secret from the service is required.
oneTimeCode.removePending: The one-time code will be removed when you save.
oneTimeCode.invalidNotice: The stored secret does not produce a code. Replace it to repair the entry.
oneTimeCode.nonConformingNotice: The stored settings are outside the accepted range (6 to 8 digits, 15 to 120 seconds). Saving forces them into range.
oneTimeCode.pasteHint: Paste the otpauth:// link from the service, or its secret. QR codes cannot be scanned here yet.
oneTimeCode.pasteInvalid: The pasted link could not be read. Only otpauth:// links for time-based codes are supported.
oneTimeCode.secretPlaceholderKeep: Leave empty to keep the current secret

errors.secret: The secret must be 16 to 128 Base32 characters (A–Z, 2–7).
errors.storedSecret: The stored secret does not produce a code. Enter a new secret to replace it.
errors.algorithm: The algorithm must be SHA1, SHA256 or SHA512.
errors.digits: A one-time code has 6 to 8 digits.
errors.period: The period must be 15 to 120 seconds.
errors.shape: The one-time code settings were not accepted. Reload the entry and try again.
errors.entryType: This entry type cannot carry a one-time code.
errors.readRequired: You need read permission on this entry to change its one-time code.

icon.title: Icon
icon.descDefault: Default icon of the entry type
icon.descMissing: The assigned database icon is no longer available
icon.storedAs: Another icon already uses this name, so the new icon was stored as "{{name}}".
icon.listFailed: The icons of this database could not be loaded.
icon.listEmpty: This database has no icons yet.
icon.listEmptyUpload: This database has no icons yet. Upload an image to add the first one.
icon.name: Icon name
icon.nameHint: The name identifies the icon within this database.
icon.uploadHint: PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP or BMP. The image is scaled to 64 × 64 pixels and stored in the database, where everyone who uses this database can see it.

errors.fileType: This file type is not supported. Choose a PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP or BMP image.
errors.fileTooLarge: The file is too large (at most {{max}}). Choose a smaller image.
errors.decode: The image could not be read. Choose another file.
errors.unsupported: This browser cannot prepare the image. Try a current browser.
errors.encodedTooLarge: Even at 64 × 64 pixels the image is larger than {{max}}. Choose a simpler image.
errors.nameEmpty: Enter a name for the icon.
errors.nameTooLong: The name may have at most 100 characters.
errors.nameTooManyBytes: The name is too long for the server. Shorten it.
errors.nameForbidden: The name contains characters that are not allowed (control characters).
errors.nameRefused: The server did not accept the icon name. Try a shorter, simpler name.
errors.image: The server could not use this image. Choose another image.
errors.tooLarge: The server refused the image as too large. Choose a simpler image.
errors.quota: This database cannot hold any more icons. Use one of the existing icons.
errors.readOnly: Icons cannot be uploaded here: the server is a read-only mirror, or you are not allowed to upload.
errors.gone: The selected icon no longer exists in this database. Choose another icon.
errors.tooLargeOrConnection: The server did not answer the upload. The image may be too large, or the connection was lost. Try again, or choose a simpler image.
errors.uploadFailed: The icon could not be uploaded. Please try again.
errors.uploadAnswer: The icon was stored, but the server's answer could not be used. Reopen the icon list and pick it there.
errors.pendingUpload: You have chosen an image that is not uploaded yet. Upload it or discard it, then save.

confirm.deleteEntryDesc: Are you sure you want to delete this entry? This action cannot be undone.
confirm.deleteEntryDescBin: Are you sure you want to delete this entry? It is moved to the server's recycle bin, from where it can be restored in the Windows client.
confirm.deleteFolderDesc: Are you sure you want to delete this folder and all its contents? This action cannot be undone.
confirm.deleteFolderDescBin: Are you sure you want to delete this folder and all its contents? They are moved to the server's recycle bin, from where they can be restored in the Windows client.
confirm.purgeItemDesc: "{{name}}" will be deleted for good. This cannot be undone.
confirm.emptyRecycleBinDesc: Everything in the recycle bin that you may delete will be deleted for good. This cannot be undone.

common.notFoundDescription: The page you're looking for doesn't exist.

toast.fileTooLarge: File is too large. Maximum size is {{max}}.
toast.recycleBinPartlyEmptied: Items you may not delete are still in the recycle bin
toast.recycleBinEmptyFailed: Recycle bin could not be emptied

errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your network connection — and, if the server uses a private TLS certificate, that the CA is trusted on this device.
errors.uploadInterrupted: The upload was interrupted before the server answered. Check your network connection and try again.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.permissionDenied: You don't have permission to perform this action. Contact your administrator if you think this is wrong.
errors.notFound: The item could not be found. It may have been deleted or moved by someone else.
errors.conflict: This change conflicts with the current state on the server. Reload and try again.
errors.rateLimit: Too many requests. Please wait a moment before trying again.
errors.serverError: The server reported an internal error. Please try again — if the problem persists, contact your administrator.
errors.loadDatabases: Could not load your databases. Please try again.

recycleBin.emptyStateHint: Entries and folders you delete are kept here until you delete them for good.
recycleBin.loadFailed: The recycle bin could not be loaded.
recycleBin.truncatedNotice: Showing the first {{count}} items of the recycle bin.
